Wildfires rip through Victoria, Australia. In Texas, a skydiving training session ends in disaster when there's a major midair collision at 30,000 feet.

In Arkansas, two storm chasers help warn people that a tornado is barrelling towards them, wreaking havoc on downtown Jonesboro and leaving a trail of destruction. In Idaho, a daredevil adventurer decides to swim beneath a frozen lake.

In Australia, the worst bushfires in recent history attack multiple towns - overwhelming firefighters and trapping tourists; The Philippines is usually resilient to natural disasters, but a 6.4 magnitude earthquake catches everyone off-guard.

An unknown tunnel is discovered beneath a Brazilian farm; a wall of molasses floods Boston; the world's first military submarine vanishes despite a successful mission; was it sunk by the enemy? Or by natural forces?

A giant explosion in Siberia flattens millions of trees; a flood comes out of nowhere to destroy an English town; defeat is snatched from the jaws of victory at Gettysburg, Pa.; poor leadership? Or a quirk of nature?
Water influences everything about Louisiana; Mike braves swamps, skies and sunken ruins to see why water draws so many to the Cajun state.
Whether it's dangling from cliff sides, handling bees, or fishing for lobsters, Mike shows off the wilder side of Maine.
Blake struggles with a hand injury, while Mack grapples with superstitions and Captain Greg closely monitors lobster prices.
Captain Gail deals with more gear sabotage, while the rest of the captains try to maximize their time on the water amid the dropping North Atlantic temperatures.
The Sedna races to escape the High Arctic; a northern town bets big on the Sealift.
Thick ice and storms threaten the Arctic Sealift before it reaches its first community.
Ice threatens to push the Sedna aground, and the Taiga is forced to skip a village.

A flash flood in the Texas Hill Country kills 13 people and destroys 350 homes; when a twister hits a small town in Mississippi, a family takes shelter in a diner's walk-in cooler; when they emerge, the town is gone.

Elite skiers on a back-country adventure are hit by an avalanche; the myth that a tornado can never strike in the mountains comes crashing down when a twister strikes a Kentucky town in the Appalachian foothills.
A flash flood at an Arkansas campsite leaves 20 dead; when a tornado pulverizes a tiny Alabama town, a doctor rescues a teenage girl who was left for dead.

Extreme flooding in Nebraska destroys a 100-year-old dam; firefighters are thrown into the raging currents of the Elkhorn River; when a cruise ship slams into a winter storm, a wave crashes into the ship, sweeping a woman away from her husband.
